title: LLM mission agent: a safety-gated MAVLink MCP server flying ArduPilot SITL
summary: A small MCP server (stdio JSON-RPC 2.0, pymavlink) that lets Claude Code or any MCP client read and fly an ArduCopter: get_state, get_nav_health (EKF flags, variances, GNSS fix/sats/HDOP => nominal/degraded/lost), arm_takeoff, goto, set_mode, plan_survey, upload_mission and set_ekf_source_set. Every command passes a configurable polygon geofence (target and straight path, with margin), an altitude band and a mode allowlist, can run in dry-run mode and is appended to a JSONL command log. A scripted client flew it against ArduPilot SITL in Docker: geofence and altitude rejections, takeoff, goto, a lawnmower survey in AUTO, simulated GPS loss, switch to the vision (ExternalNav) source set and RTL to landing. Includes registration next to the navigation-index MCP server, prompt recipes, a Claude tool-use loop and a comparison with MAVLinkMCP.
verified: Ran on 2026-11-06 against ArduCopter Copter-4.6.3 SITL in Docker (samples/sitl-docker image, linux/arm64) with pymavlink 2.4.50 on python3.13 (uv venv): scripted MCP client drove the server through fence and altitude rejections, arm_takeoff to 20 m, goto (arrived), plan_survey + upload_mission (12 items, AUTO), SIM_GPS_DISABLE=1 => get_nav_health degraded (gnss_ok false), set_ekf_source_set 2 (ExternalNav) accepted, RTL to landing and disarm; dry-run scenario also run. Transcripts in example_output/. 24 stdlib unit tests pass on python3.14.7. agent_loop.py was not run against the API (no ANTHROPIC_API_KEY in the environment); the Claude Code registration commands were not executed.
